name: sweepdeck-monorepo
description: SweepDeck — cross-platform disk cleaner & system optimizer built with graph engineering methods

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/app
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w packages/app --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/app
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w packages/app
